```sql
SELECT season,
       winner AS team,
       wins
FROM (
    SELECT season,
           winner,
           COUNT(*) AS wins,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM matches
    WHERE winner IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY season, winner
) AS ranked_wins
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY season;
```
